 Make kajjali from Parada and Gandhak in a kharal yantra.

fullContent:
Kamdev Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Vajikaranadhikar 1134/100-107 
 Introduction 
 Kamdev rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. This is a classical Ayurvedic medicine used as aphrodisiac. It enhances sperm motility and sexual power. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada (Purified Mercury) – 1 Part 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 2 Parts 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada – It is a purified form of mercury means mercury is used as a medicine after purification. It has Rasayan property. It is used to treat numerous diseases. It balances all three dosha. It is useful in enhancing sperm production. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – It is a purified form of Sulphur. It is beneficial in promoting digestive fire and balances vata and kapha dosha. It enhances sexual power and sperm motility. It also balances Agni. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Make kajjali from Parada and Gandhak in a kharal yantra. 
 Give Bhavna with the extract of red variety of karpas ( Gossypium ). 
 Keep this kajjali with Tankan (Borax) in a glass container which is painted with soil. 
 Cooked this mixture over low, medium and high flames. 
 After third day, take out this mixture from that glass container and you can get this shiny Parada 
 Make a fine powder of this shiny Parada and keep in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kamdev rasa is a classical medicine which is used in various sexual problems. This formulation is useful in increasing sperm production. It helps in boosting up the testosterone level which is a male sex hormone that is useful in increasing libido (sexual desire). This formulation is also effective in infertile women. It provides strength to the body. 
 Indications 
 
 Oligospermia 
 Erectile Dysfunction 
 Infertility 
 
 Dosage 
 60-125 mg twice daily with honey or Cow’s milk. 
 Cautions 
 It should be taken under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
